title: POV: You Owe $14,000… Jake Pays Minimums for 7 YEARS, You're Free in 29 Months 😳

lines: You owe fourteen thousand dollars. A medical bill, a car loan, and a credit card at twenty five percent.
scenes.img: {HERO} at a kitchen table at night staring at a pile of bills and a calculator, serious face, vertical composition

lines: Jake has the same pile. He just pays the minimums.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt on a couch lazily paying a bill on his phone, vertical composition

lines: That card alone takes him over seven years. And about nine thousand five hundred dollars in interest.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt surrounded by flying calendar pages, shocked face, vertical composition

lines: You find one hundred seventy dollars extra a month. Six hundred total.
scenes.img: {HERO} writing a number in a notebook with a confident smile, coins jar beside him, vertical composition

lines: Mia rolls a snowball: smallest debt first. Debt free in thirty months.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail rolling a big snowball down a snowy hill with a big smile, vertical composition

lines: You start an avalanche: highest interest first. Debt free in twenty nine months.
scenes.img: {HERO} standing on a snowy mountain top with arms raised at sunrise, vertical composition

lines: And you pay about nine hundred dollars less interest than Mia.
scenes.img: {HERO} putting cash into a piggy bank with a calm satisfied smile, vertical composition

lines: Snowball or avalanche? Which one is right for you? The full story is on my channel.
scenes.img: {HERO} waving at the viewer with a friendly smile in a cozy living room, vertical composition
